title: Starry Night in Wheat Field
description: A young Black woman with long dark hair lies on her back in a golden wheat field at night, wearing a flowing white dress. Her arms are relaxed by her sides as she gazes upward at a vibrant, star-filled sky featuring the Milky Way and a bright horizon glow.
prompt: A young Black woman with long flowing dark hair lies peacefully on her back in a vast golden wheat field at night, wearing a delicate white dress with puffed sleeves. Her arms rest gently by her sides with palms open as she gazes up at the cosmos. The dramatic night sky is filled with countless bright stars and the glowing band of the Milky Way, with a luminous horizon light cutting across the scene, in a highly detailed realistic digital painting style.
